Title case that leaves an acronym alone

Source: R/calculator.R
mm_title_case.Rd

Factor levels arrive as they were typed into a data-entry form: "member", "senior elections", "no AOA at school". Printed in a dropdown beside sentence-cased labels they read as unfinished. Naive title case is worse, because it turns AOA into Aoa and USMLE into Usmle, so a word carrying a capital of its own is left exactly as it is, and the short joining words stay lowercase unless they open or close the phrase.

Usage

mm_title_case(x)

Arguments

x

A character vector.

Value

The same vector, title cased.

Details

This changes what is shown and never what is submitted: the dropdown's values stay the levels the fit knows, because mm_predict() refuses a level it has not seen and a prettier spelling is exactly that.
